name: best_vary_mix
description: Best-spot isolate (warm-start). Fixed at radius 0.12, sel_sigma 0.2, n_select 100, top-3 detectors; sweeps the rehearsal mix — mix_ratio (guided fraction alpha) x sel_method (weakpoint distance / weight by landscape / shape aware) — AND initial-training time iters_initial [10,20,50,100,200], which brackets the ~50 whole-area sweet spot (a less-trained initial model leaves a real weakspot to fix, so guided can win over the whole area, not just in the gap). 9 mix_ratio x 3 sel_method x 5 iters_initial x 3 seeds = 405 configs.
